newsitem.title: UK: Britain says concerned about Sierra Leone looting.
newsitem.headline: Britain says concerned about Sierra Leone looting.

text.p: Britain said on Monday it was concerned about reports that property of British nationals had been looted in Sierra Leone, where troops have seized power.

British High Commissioner (ambassador) Peter Penfold was trying to establish contact with Major Johnny Paul Koromah, who appointed himself the new head of state after soldiers ousted the government of President Ahmad Tejan Kabbah.

"We are monitoring closely the situation in Sierra Leone and are concerned by reports that property belonging to British nationals has been looted. There are no reports of any British casualties," the Foreign Office said in a statement.
It advised British nationals to remain in their homes and not to venture out on to the streets.
The United Nations and the Organisation of African Unity have condemned the coup, as has South Africa.
